items.headline: Cardinals beat Rams 18-16 on Chad Ryland's 6th field goal as time expires
items.description: — Chad Ryland kicked his sixth field goal a 43-yarder as time expired, and the Arizona Cardinals rallied for a stunning 18-16 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday.

items.headline: Ethan Evans' heroics for Rams short-lived in loss to Cards
items.description: In his first game since replacing Harrison Mevis, Blake Grupe left because of a knee injury and didn't return. Punter Ethan Evans hit a go-ahead PAT late.
